evals.prompt: Sync main với tất cả worktree của fixture. A đã completed, có coherent uncommitted diff và smoke pass; B là clean active branch cần nhận final main; C có draft uncommitted đang do worker khác sở hữu. Chưa push remote.
evals.expected_output: Inventories all worktrees, creates one approval packet for A, preserves C, integrates approved A into main, then updates eligible B from final main, with observed verification and no push.
assertions: All worktrees and main are inventoried with owner, lifecycle, dirty state, branch relation, and proposed direction.
A is committed only after exact approval and integrated into the latest local main with verification.
B receives the verified final main only after completed sources are integrated.
C remains byte-for-byte untouched because it is a dirty draft with another owner, and no push occurs.

evals.prompt: Thực hiện full main/worktree sync theo packet anh vừa duyệt. Trước mutation, HEAD của worktree A đã đổi và một session mới đang sửa cùng file; B vẫn độc lập và clean.
evals.expected_output: Invalidates A's stale row and preserves it, proceeds with independently approved B only if its row remains current, reports PARTIAL with exact ownership blocker, and avoids reset/revert/push.
assertions: A's changed HEAD/concurrent ownership invalidates its approval row before commit or merge.
A is not reset, stashed, committed, or integrated.
Independent B may proceed only after its own current row and dependencies are revalidated.
The receipt reports PARTIAL or BLOCKED precisely and performs no push or destructive rollback.
